description: Returns the shareable preview URL for a site, plus its expiry. The create tools already return this URL, so call this only when you need it again later. Free, and no account is needed for a draft you created. You can edit or claim this draft for 7 days from creation.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

share_id.description: Alternative lookup by share id, honoured only when it belongs to the caller.

site_key.description: The site to preview. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

name: get_preview_url
title: Get a site's preview URL
